title: Everything your labour consultancy needs to manage clients and compliance.
description: From client onboarding and compliance tracking to payroll, documents, notices and client communication, LabourFlow brings your consultancy workflow into one connected platform.

items.title: Client Management
items.description: Manage client companies, branches and employee rosters from one centralized, searchable workspace.

items.title: Compliance Configuration
items.description: Configure applicable labour laws and statutory requirements for each client based on their industry and workforce.

items.title: Compliance Calendar
items.description: Track PF, ESI, PT, LWF, returns, licence renewals and recurring obligations with deadlines and responsibilities.

items.title: Payroll & Statutory Calculations
items.description: Process attendance and payroll with PF, ESI, PT, LWF, bonus and gratuity calculations, plus statutory outputs.

items.title: Document Vault
items.description: Organize licences, agreements, certificates and client records with expiry tracking, version history and search.

items.title: Notices & Reminders
items.description: Track government notices, reply deadlines and requirements while sending automated WhatsApp and email reminders.

items.title: Inspection-Ready Records
items.description: Pull together documents, registers, returns and compliance history for any client in one click when an inspector or notice arrives.

items.title: Client Portal
items.description: Give clients a secure space to upload documents, view compliance status, check due dates and access reports.

items.title: Tasks & Team Workflow
items.description: Assign work to consultants and staff, track progress and maintain clear visibility across your consultancy.

items.title: Advanced Security & Privacy
items.description: Protect sensitive client and employee data with role-based access, secure storage and controlled user permissions.
